rationale: All four singular-to-plural noun pairs and all four singular-to-base verb pairs share the exact displacement [0,0,0,2]. Reverse transformations share its negative. Thus birds:bird::cats:cat, dog:dogs::horse:horses, eats:eat::runs:run, and jump:jumps::sleep:sleeps each reach the expected embedding at zero squared distance. Every token has a distinct embedding, so every demonstrated transformation and every analogous transfer among these pairs has a unique exact answer.
